definition: The sample autocorrelation of log returns at lag bars over the last window prices.
boundaries: Linear dependence at one lag only; bid-ask bounce on short bars reads as negative autocorrelation. Missing while the returns have no spread.
recognition: Positive when moves follow moves, negative when they reverse.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
